mechanisms.rationale: Converts sync execFileSync subprocess dispatch to async execFile with manual Promise wrapper (close + error event handlers). Cannot ship independently because call-site signatures must change from const r = run(...) to const r = await run(...) — the return type changes from plain object to Promise. Must ship atomically with call-site await changes. This mechanism was described in the Proposal and Plan but was NOT committed (c2864b6b retains sync execFileSync).

Extracts 13 blocks (block13-block25) into async functions, groups 7 own-workspace blocks (13,17,18,19,20,21,22) into Promise.all, and organizes remaining shared-resource blocks into serial phases. Ships independent structural value even without async run(): (a) code organization — each block is a named function with clear boundaries; (b) the concurrent-set membership is structurally proven (grep for mkdtempSync inside Promise.all blocks confirms own-workspace isolation); (c) the three-phase skeleton sets up for incremental concurrency fixes (e.g., converting seeding calls to async runNative). Actually committed in c2864b6b.

makeAssert(tag) factory wraps the existing assert() logic with a block-level tag prefix (e.g., [search] PASS: ...). Ships independent debugging value: a deliberately-broken assertion in a concurrent block names its origin without requiring a serial re-run (AC-4). The failures counter safety is guaranteed by JavaScript event-loop serialization of synchronous assert() calls after await. Already committed in c2864b6b.
